kind: single-command multi-cohort worker and automatic node allocation; software verification
user_instruction: 야 그리고2개 명령어 분리하지 말고1개로 만들어. 알아서 자동배치되게 하고; 지금 빨리 수정해
hypothesis: Identical workers can share ready jobs from both independent cohort queues without fixed node shares, while keeping each cohort budget, inputs, checkpoints and phase barriers independent.

implementation.dispatch: work-conserving round-robin across ready cohort queues; no per-model node quota; one child GPU job per worker
implementation.waiting: busy/dependency-blocked/completed cohort does not reserve otherwise usable workers
implementation.failure: failed GPU task stops dispatch for that cohort, preserves failure/attempts, healthy cohort continues; final worker exit is nonzero if either failed; preflight exceptions remain visible
implementation.identity: per-cohort exact source/config/input/trainer binding and actual selected child interpreter package versions
implementation.environments: OLMo uses optional V8_PYTHON_OLMO_MATH/PAIR_PYTHON; Qwen uses optional V8_PYTHON_QWEN_MBPP/SWITCH_PYTHON; fallback common Python
implementation.recovery: same job/checkpoint IDs and existing full recovery state; strict queue binding rejects unverified coordinator upgrades; no automatic existing-queue migration

data_model_transformation.data: generated toy features/answers only; actual V8 planner/runner/evaluator
data_model_transformation.model: CPU ToyBackend for both cohort identities; no real OLMo/Qwen model trained
controls: one worker automatically completes both cohorts
three workers automatically move between actual V8 CPU cohorts

metric_definitions.task: Unique actual task identity in coordinator attempt/execution records; stage-dependent count, not scientific measurement
metric_definitions.overlap: For each worker, no overlap in recorded task attempt start/end intervals across either cohort
metric_definitions.heldout: Integer per-question final evaluation counts separately recorded from training-batch rewards; omitted intermediate held-out remains unmeasured
metric_definitions.capacity: Upper bound from configured training dependency graph, verified using synthetic snapshot metadata; not measured GPU concurrency or recommended allocation

olmo_math.scope: CPU multi-process software integration; not scientific RLVR results

qwen_mbpp.scope: CPU multi-process software integration; not scientific RLVR results

mixed_integration.scope: CPU multi-cohort software verification, not scientific RLVR measurements

training_parallel_capacity.derivation: Each of5seeds has10SR branches and either one active On trajectory or its dependent Uniform branch. On and its Uniform successor cannot overlap. Phase barriers separate training/extension/evaluation.
training_parallel_capacity.qualification: This is a theoretical training graph bound. Initial prefixes expose10jobs per cohort; later checkpoint readiness and actual job durations limit concurrency. Evaluation count depends on selected checkpoint identities and deduplication, so it is not claimed to equal this training bound.

provenance.prior_failures: Earlier scheduler and budget-coverage failures remain in research/v8-multinode-20261108/ and research/v8-budget-endpoint-20261108/

limitations: Existing queue bindings are immutable for compatibility; stop old worker versions before changing tools and do not rewrite metadata by hand.
Same shared V8_ROOT with cross-node POSIX flock and consistent pinned code/environment required.
No node purchase/allocation or actual GPU execution was performed.
